# Sensors (`sensors`)

Perception and localization capabilities.

Groups are in bold; leaves (ODD parameters) are in code font with type, unit, physical bounds and nominal distribution.

- **perception** (Perception): Detecting objects and people around the robot.
  - `sensor_range` (continuous; m; [0.1, 200]): Maximum range at which the perception system reports detections. Aliases: detection range, perception range, lidar range, camera range.
- **localization** (Localization): Knowing where the robot is.
  - `localization_noise` (continuous; m; [0, 5]): Standard deviation of the robot's position estimate error. Aliases: localization error, pose noise, position uncertainty, drift.
  - `gnss_availability` (boolean; bernoulli(0.9)): Whether satellite positioning is available. Aliases: gps, gnss, satellite fix, gps denied.
